role: Draws the two unique Daily Report pages — page 1 "Today, in one glance" (header, loop verdict hero, This Morning / Today's Workout stat columns, The Loop paragraph, Tomorrow line) and page 2 "Why" (combined readiness box, contribution bars, What's helping / hurting) — plus the drawing primitives they share.
types: HolisticDailyReport: extension — page drawing and row builders
toplevel: No stored state. All drawing is absolute-positioned with no page-break logic; both pages end with drawFooter (page 1 via drawGlanceTomorrow, page 2 via drawHelpingHurting).

flags.text: Page 1 and page 2 lay out content top-down with no bounds check against the footer at pageHeight−margin+6 (762pt); a long or translated verdict blurb, loop paragraph or tomorrow line pushes content into or past the footer/disclaimer, since nothing paginates.
drawText, drawWrappedText and formatDuration re-implement WorkoutPDFRenderer's helpers of the same names (comment at line 513 says they mirror them).

units.does: Starts page 1 (mirrored for RTL) and draws header, hero verdict and the two columns + loop + tomorrow sections down from the top margin.
Draws "EMUQU · DAILY REPORT", a strong divider, the upper-cased full date of the workout start in the app locale, and the right-aligned load as-of line; returns y below.
Draws the live-load disclosure ("Live · updated <time>") right-aligned at the date line in 9pt tertiary; nothing for a past day or cold cache.

branches.effect: returns without drawing; otherwise draws it

units.does: Formats a date with DateFormatter .full date style in LanguageManager.appLocale and upper-cases it in that locale.
Draws the loop-verdict hero: a tinted rounded rect (height max(96, 48+blurb height+16)) with a 6pt tone-coloured left bar, label and wrapped blurb; returns y below + 22.
Draws the hero label in 22pt heavy tone colour and the blurb wrapped at 12pt/15pt line height inside the hero rect.
Splits the content width into two columns (18pt gap), draws This Morning (left) and Today's Workout (right), then the loop paragraph and tomorrow line below the taller column.
Draws the "THIS MORNING" header and a thin divider, then the morning recovery stat rows; returns the column bottom.
Draws the morning recovery rows at the left margin (colW and bundle unused).
Draws each GlanceRow: 9pt tertiary label, 18pt semibold value, optional coloured sub-line, 6pt gap; returns y below the last row.

branches.effect: draws label, value and sub-line, advancing y

units.does: Draws the row sub-line 22pt below the value in the row colour (default textSecondary) and returns the height consumed (34 with sub-line, 22 without).
Draws the "TODAY'S WORKOUT" header at rightX and the workout stat rows; returns the column bottom.
Strokes a thin divider across the right column directly on the current CGContext, then draws the workout output rows at rightX.

branches.effect: strokes the divider; otherwise no divider (rows still drawn)

flags.text: Inline copy of drawDivider's non-strong stroke, written out because drawDivider hard-codes x = config.margin.

units.does: Draws "THE LOOP" header and the DailyLoopAnalysis loop paragraph wrapped at 12pt/16pt across the content width; returns y + 18.
Draws the "TOMORROW" header, the tomorrow action line, and the page-1 footer.
Draws the reading-direction arrow bullet in sage and the DailyLoopAnalysis tomorrow action wrapped beside it.
Colour for the 0-10 readiness value: sage >= 7.5, amber >= 5.5, else primary.

flags.text: Doc says these are "the same bands the dashboard pill uses", but ScoreVerdict colours 75+ optimal, 60–75 good, 45–60 caution, <45 attention (ScoreVerdict.swift:32-36,111-115); the PDF has no 60 or 45 cut and colours 55–60 amber like 60–75.

units.does: Builds the This Morning rows: a single amber "Status: No morning data / Start an overnight session…" row when there is no overnight session; otherwise HRV, sleep and training-balance rows that exist.

branches.effect: returns the single "No morning data" row; otherwise the three optional rows

units.does: HRV row: overnight RMSSD in ms with optional "+x% vs your recent baseline" sub-line coloured sage (>= +5%), primary (<= −5%) or secondary.

branches.effect: adds the sub-line; otherwise no sub-line

units.does: Sleep row: night sleep as hours-minutes with sub-line "<eff>% efficiency" or "Efficiency not measured".
Form (TSB) row from trainingLoadForReport: signed TSB with "Fresh — quality session ready" (TSB > 5, sage), "Tired — go easy or rest" (TSB < −10, primary) or "Balanced load".

branches.effect: Tired — go easy or rest / primary; otherwise Balanced load / secondary

flags.text: Page 1 prints "Tired — go easy or rest" for any TSB below −10, but the advice gate only treats TSB <= −15 as heavy fatigue; with TSB between −15 and −10 and a clear load, page 2 of the same PDF can print "Tier 1 — go hard" or "Tier 2 — quality OK" while page 1 says go easy or rest.

units.does: Builds the Today's Workout rows: summary, internal load (TRIMP), HRSS, 1-min HRR, dropping those that are nil.
Summary row: upper-cased sport name as the label and "<distance> · <duration>" as the value.
Internal load row: "TRIMP n" with the DailyLoopAnalysis intensity class label (easy/tempo in sage, hard in primary).
HRSS row: rounded workoutMetadata.hrTSS with the "1hr@LTHR = 100" sub-line.
1-min HRR row: "−N bpm" with interpretation (>= 18 strong vagal recovery sage, >= 12 at/above the maximal-testing cut-off sage, else below it amber).

branches.effect: "At or above 12 bpm (cut-off from maximal testing)", sage; otherwise "Below 12 bpm…", amber

units.does: Returns analysis().loopParagraph (shared with the Dashboard card).
Returns analysis().tomorrowAction (shared with the Dashboard card).
Starts page 2 and draws the "WHY" title, a strong divider, the readiness synthesis box, contribution bars and helping/hurting sections.
Computes the combined readiness, draws a 60pt tinted rounded box in its band colour with the score labels; returns y below + 22.
Draws "x.x / 10" in 22pt heavy band colour, "Combined Readiness" caption, and the tier text at x+200.
Recomputes the combined readiness, draws the "CONTRIBUTIONS" header and one bar per contribution; returns y below.

branches.effect: draws a labelled bar, threading y

flags.text: combinedReadinessScore() is computed twice per page (here and in drawScoreSynthesis), each run rebuilding the analysis and advice-gate assessment.

units.does: Draws one contribution: name at left, right-aligned monospaced "score × weight%", the filled track, and the note sub-line; returns y below.
Draws a 6pt rounded gray track across the content width and fills score/10 (clamped 0..1) of it in the readiness band colour.
Draws the contribution note in 9pt tertiary and returns y + 18.
Draws "WHAT'S HELPING" (up to 4 sage bullets) and, 10pt lower if helping was non-empty, "WHAT'S HURTING" (up to 3 primary bullets), then the page-2 footer.

branches.effect: adds 10pt spacing before the hurting section; otherwise none

units.does: Draws a titled bullet list capped at `limit` points with coloured dots and 11pt wrapped text; returns y unchanged (and no heading) when there are no points.

branches.cond: for each of the first `limit` points
branches.effect: draws a dot and wrapped text, advancing y; extra points are dropped silently

units.does: Draws a single-line string at a point with font and colour via the RTL-aware pdfDraw.
Builds the attributed text, measures its height at `width`, draws it into a rect of exactly that height and returns origin.y + height.
Measures the height of text laid out with wrappedAttributedText at `width` (usesLineFragmentOrigin + usesFontLeading).
Returns an NSAttributedString with font, colour and an RTL-aware paragraph style whose lineSpacing = max(0, lineHeight − font.lineHeight).
Strokes a horizontal divider from the left margin across `width` on the current context: 1.2pt half-alpha primary when strong, 0.5pt divider gray otherwise.

branches.effect: stroke colour primary@0.5 alpha; otherwise config.divider

units.does: Draws the footer at pageHeight−margin+6: a thin divider, "Emuqu · Daily Report · Page N · <ISO-8601 generation time>", and the wellness/not-a-medical-device disclaimer on the next caption line.
Formats seconds as h:mm:ss when an hour or more, else m:ss.
